name: Annulment
overview: Scripture affirms the sacredness and permanence of marriage, emphasizing that a man and woman become one flesh, united by God (Genesis 2:24; Matthew 19:6). While divorce is acknowledged in the law (Numbers 30:1; Matthew 5:31), God expresses His hatred for the act of putting away a spouse, warning against treachery and violence in such decisions (Malachi 2:16). Jesus clarifies that except for the cause of fornication, divorce leads to adultery, underscoring the seriousness with which God regards marital faithfulness and the binding nature of the marriage covenant (Matthew 5:32).
